scope.note: only files that build a markdown page (.md literal + a writer call) are reported; f-strings and .format() are out of scope; the residue is checked against the published .md corpus so a reader-visible finding carries its page, not just its source line

suppressed_rules.RELAXED_PRECISION: the offending '%' is a precision with no digits (%.f / %0.f), legal printf
suppressed_rules.TEMPLATE_APPLIED_LATER: the literal is bound to a name (or to a container of names) that is later used as '<name> %% ...' or unpacked into a %-applied member
